relationships.subject: Oxaliplatin
relationships.evidence_quote: Western blot analysis showed an increased amount of H3Cit in the DRG of oxaliplatin-treated mice compared with saline-treated mice (Fig. 1C).

relationships.subject: PAD4
relationships.evidence_quote: The inhibition of PAD4 or MPO by genetic ablation, Cl-amidine, or PF-1355 reduced the level of H3Cit in plasma and significantly improved oxaliplatin-induced mechanical hyperalgesia

relationships.subject: Neutrophil extracellular traps
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicated that NETs provide an NLRP3 priming signal and oxaliplatin provides an activating signal in IL1β and IL18 production.

relationships.subject: NLRP3 inflammasome
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, inhibition of NLRP3 by genetic ablation or using the NLRP3 inhibitor MCC950 significantly alleviated OIPN (Fig. 5S and T).

relationships.subject: IL-18
relationships.evidence_quote: Furthermore, we found that administration of IL18 to Nlrp3−/− mice elicited mechanical hyperalgesia (Fig. 5V).

relationships.subject: IL18BP
relationships.evidence_quote: Symptoms of mechanical hyperalgesia were significantly reversed by IL18BP (Fig. 5U).

relationships.subject: TLR7
relationships.evidence_quote: The qPCR data showed that TLR7 and TLR9 inhibitors efficiently inhibited the increased transcription of Il1b, Il6, and Tnfa induced by NETs (Fig. 4E–G).

relationships.subject: Eicosapentaenoic acid
relationships.evidence_quote: We observed that pretreatment of BMDMs with EPA blocked NET-induced caspase-1 activation and maturation of IL18 in the presence of oxaliplatin (Fig. 7D–G).

relationships.subject: IL-18
relationships.evidence_quote: western blot data showed that the phosphorylation of GluN2B Tyr1472 increased in the spinal cord after oxaliplatin treatment and this increase was significantly suppressed by IL18BP treatment (Fig. 5W).

key_findings: Oxaliplatin induces NETs (via gut-derived LPS) in DRG and plasma; NETs prime and oxaliplatin activates NLRP3 in macrophages, releasing IL-18 that drives mechanical hyperalgesia.
EPA suppressed NET formation and NLRP3/caspase-1/IL-18 and prevented OIPN in mice.
